name: Ruins of the Swedish Factory, Macao, 1831
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A drawing of overgrown ruins and stone blocks lying on the ground. The 'Swedish factory' - the building used to accommodate Swedish merchants in Macau between trading seasons at Guangzhou (Canton) - was situated between the Leal Senado and the Franciscan Green. For a view from close by see E.1746-19
